description: ERA5 South Asian low-pressure-system catalogue with hourly-complete physical-event identities and a six-hour wind-plus-land-closed-isobar IMD-equivalent intensity classification

identity.track_id: one hourly-complete physical event and the only public event identifier; use for plotting, counts, matching and climatology

calibration.existence: unchanged from v5.5; no genesis-location rule
calibration.intensity: v5.5 background-removed circulation-wind thresholds plus a land-only two-closed-isobar depression floor, all with six-hour persistence on complete hourly trajectories
